original_visible_content.stem: An authorized pharmacist practising collaborative drug therapy management in a Massachusetts community pharmacy is asked during an inspection to produce the collaborative practice documents. Which statements about what this pharmacist is required to hold are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The pharmacist must hold the signed original rather than a copy.
A copy of the current collaborative practice agreement must be maintained.
Copies of the current patient referral and patient consent must be included.
The documents must be maintained in the primary practice setting.
The documents must be readily retrievable when they are requested.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 16.04(6) requires an authorized pharmacist to maintain a COPY of the current CDTM agreement, including copies of the current patient referral and patient consent, in the primary practice setting, readily retrievable on request. The original belongs with the supervising physician under 243 CMR 2.12.

choice_analysis.A: The original is the supervising physician's to keep, in the patient's medical record.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: a copy of the current agreement.
choice_analysis.C: Correct: the referral and consent copies travel with the agreement.
choice_analysis.D: Correct: the primary practice setting is the specified location.
choice_analysis.E: Correct: ready retrievability on request is required.

Case B: During inspection, the pharmacist says the physician holds the agreement and therefore no readily retrievable copy is needed at the pharmacist's primary practice setting.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Any old electronic draft substitutes for the current signed agreement.
Nonrenewal permits immediate abandonment of ongoing therapy without a transition plan.
Telling only pharmacy employees satisfies patient termination notice.
The pharmacist keeps the current agreement and required referral or consent copies readily retrievable at the primary setting.

explanation.core_reasoning: 종료 전에 약물치료가 중단되지 않도록 continuation 절차를 마련한다. 양측의 원본·사본 보관 책임을 구분한다. 환자에게 서면 통지하고 이후 치료를 지속할 절차를 안내해야 한다. 전자화가 version consistency와 현재 유효한 agreement의 필요성을 없애지 않는다.

선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 전자화가 version consistency와 현재 유효한 agreement의 필요성을 없애지 않는다.
교정된 설명: Electronic storage must preserve access and the applicable current version.
choice_analysis.B:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 종료 전에 약물치료가 중단되지 않도록 continuation 절차를 마련한다.
교정된 설명: Therapy continuation must be arranged before termination or nonrenewal as required.
choice_analysis.C:

A pharmacy and physician are updating a CDTM agreement. They also need a process for patients if the agreement is not renewed.

Which provisions are consistent with the described CDTM requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Arrange uninterrupted drug-therapy continuation before termination or nonrenewal.
Review and renew the agreement at least every two years.
Delegate pharmacist prescribing decisions to a technician through an agreement clause.
Keep the old agreement active indefinitely after the supervising physician leaves practice.
Provide patients written notice and instructions for continuing care when the agreement ends.

explanation.core_reasoning: CPA는 작성 시점에만 확인하는 서류가 아니다. Review·renewal, 권한 범위, 종료 시 환자 치료 지속을 함께 관리한다.

choice_analysis.A: 계약 종료가 환자 치료의 공백을 만들지 않도록 한다.
choice_analysis.B: CPA의 적어도 2년마다 review·renew 요건이다.
choice_analysis.C: CPA 문구는 technician의 법정 scope를 확대하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.D: 현재 유효한 협약·감독 구조를 검토하지 않고 무기한 승계할 수 없다.
choice_analysis.E: 환자 통지·치료 지속 안내를 직원 간 문서로만 대신하지 않는다.

explanation.learning_boundary: 한 판단을 위한 개별 작성 사례. 기존 원칙을 더 명확한 사례로 연습하며 새로운 법규 96개 또는 최근 기출의 재현이라는 뜻은 아닙니다.

original_visible_content.stem:
A Board inspector asks a community CDTM pharmacist for the current agreement and the participating patients' referral and consent records. The pharmacist can retrieve only a superseded agreement. The physician holds the current documents, but the physician's office is closed and the pharmacist has no access to them.

Which corrective arrangement addresses the pharmacy-side requirement? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Keep the superseded copy and obtain a verbal assurance from the physician that a current one exists.
Keep current agreement, referral and consent copies readily retrievable at the primary practice site.
Leave the current records solely with the physician because the physician retains original documents.
Ask patients to bring their copies when an inspection occurs, without keeping pharmacy-accessible copies.

explanation.core_reasoning: 환자·의사에게 자료가 존재하는 것과 약사가 자신의 primary practice setting에서 현재 사본을 제시할 수 있는 것은 다르다. 오래된 버전이나 외부 사무실의 접근 불가 자료로 이 요건을 충족했다고 보지 않는다.

choice_analysis.A: 과거 협약과 구두 확인은 현재 협약 사본 및 현재 환자 의뢰·동의 기록을 대체하지 않는다. 규정은 요청 시 readily retrievable한 현재 자료를 요구한다.
choice_analysis.B: 약사는 주된 실무 setting에 현재 협약과 현재 환자 의뢰·동의 사본을 두고 두 Board의 요청 시 쉽게 검색·제시할 수 있어야 한다. 특정 종이 양식만을 요구한다는 뜻은 아니다.

choice_analysis.D: 환자의 사본은 약사의 primary practice setting에서 현재 기록을 readily retrievable하게 유지할 의무를 대신하지 않는다.

explanation.learning_boundary: 기존 대표 문항을 별도 사례로 다시 작성했습니다. 원본과 새 문항의 풀이 기록은 각각 보존됩니다. 작성자 출처 대조와 편집 검토이며 독립 법규 감사 또는 실제 시험 난도 보정은 아닙니다.

original_visible_content.stem: A Massachusetts retail pharmacy proposes to engage a physician on two footings: to conduct quality assurance reviews of the pharmacists it employs who practise collaborative drug therapy management, and to enter into collaborative practice agreements with the pharmacy's patients. Which analysis is correct?

choices.text: Both engagements are permitted, since the pharmacy is not itself prescribing.
Both engagements are prohibited, since a retail pharmacy may not employ a physician.
The agreement engagement is permitted and the review engagement is prohibited.
Both are permitted if the physician's pay is unrelated to prescription volume.
The review engagement is permitted and the agreement engagement is prohibited.

explanation.core_reasoning: M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24B1/2(e), implemented at 247 CMR 16.04(7), bars a retail pharmacy from employing a physician FOR THE PURPOSE of maintaining, establishing or entering into a collaborative practice agreement, while expressly preserving the pharmacy's ability to hire a physician or licensed medical practitioner to conduct quality assurance reviews of its collaborating pharmacists.

choice_analysis.A: The statute regulates the employment relationship itself, not the act of prescribing.
choice_analysis.B: The quality assurance engagement is expressly preserved.
choice_analysis.C: This reverses the statute: the agreement purpose is the prohibited one.
choice_analysis.D: Compensation structure is not the statutory test; purpose is.
choice_analysis.E: Correct: purpose decides, and only the agreement purpose is barred.

A nationally certified licensed technician loads pharmacist-verified gabapentin under the ordinary supervised licensed-technician pathway.

choice_analysis.B: 8.03(4)(c)는 trainee의 전화 prescription 수신을 제한한다. 일반 direct supervision으로 이 별도 제한을 없애지 못한다.

choice_analysis.E: Correct. This adult repeat-dose Abilify Maintena request satisfies the conditions stated in the option.

A pharmacist is preparing a vaccination clinic. A prescriber has signed the routine vaccine standing order, but it has no emergency-medication instructions. Which actions are needed for an appropriate standing-order packet? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Obtain actual prescriber authorization covering the emergency medications used for vaccine reactions.
Include emergency medication doses and routes, together with instructions for continued care such as contacting 911.
File the unsigned DPH-linked model as sufficient medication authority because the resource is officially listed.
Ensure the revised order identifies who may administer and is signed by a duly authorized prescriber.
Replace the emergency-medication order with documentation that epinephrine is stocked at the clinic.

explanation.core_reasoning: 주문서의 출처가 공식인지와 실제로 권한 있는 prescriber가 이 투여를 승인했는지는 별개다. 백신·응급약의 실제 권한, 구체적 응급 처치 내용, 투여 주체와 서명을 갖추되 두 개의 별도 물리적 양식을 필수라고 만들지 않는다.

choice_analysis.A: 백신 명령과 별도로 응급약 투여에도 처방 또는 standing order에 의한 권한이 필요하다. 미서명 모델은 실제 prescriber authorization이 아니다. 반드시 별도 종이 두 장이어야 한다는 의미는 아니다.
choice_analysis.B: Appendix는 응급약 이름·용량·경로와 계속 진료를 위한 지원 절차를 명령에 포함하도록 한다. 단순히 응급 대응이 필요하다고 쓰는 것으로는 부족하다.
choice_analysis.C: 공식 기관이 제공하거나 연결한 모델은 작성 도구이지 이 약국의 실제 서명된 처방을 자동으로 구성하지 않는다. 응급약 투여 권한과 duly authorized prescriber의 서명 요건이 남는다.
choice_analysis.D: standing order에는 누가 투여할 수 있는지와 적법한 prescriber의 서명이 포함되어야 한다. 모델의 공란을 남겨둔 채 실무 승인으로 취급하면 안 된다.
choice_analysis.E: 약품이 준비되어 있다는 재고 기록은 투여를 허용하는 처방·standing order를 대신하지 않는다. 준비 상태와 법적 투여 권한을 모두 확인해야 한다.

explanation.learning_boundary: 기존 대표 문항을 별도 사례로 다시 작성했습니다. 원본과 새 문항의 풀이 기록은 각각 보존됩니다. 작성자 출처 대조와 편집 검토이며 독립 법규 감사 또는 실제 시험 난도 보정은 아닙니다.

original_visible_content.stem: A wholesaler receives an electronic CSOS order for oxycodone from a pharmacy. Print the electronic order and treat the printout as a valid paper DEA Form 222.
Reject the electronic order rather than fill it on the revoked certificate; the purchaser must submit a valid authorized order.
Ship half the order because a partial shipment reduces the risk created by the revoked certificate.
Hold the order until 60 days after execution, when the certificate-revocation issue no longer matters.

explanation.core_reasoning: The supplier has its own CSOS validity gate. Complete product fields are not enough when the required DEA digital certificate is revoked or otherwise invalid.

choice_analysis.A: CSOS validity requires a valid DEA-issued digital certificate as well as complete order data.
choice_analysis.B: Printing does not convert an invalid CSOS signature into a valid paper order form.
choice_analysis.C: Supplier validation includes certificate validity, and a revoked certificate cannot support the required digital signature.
choice_analysis.D: Partial shipment does not cure an invalid electronic order.
choice_analysis.E: Time does not cure an invalid/revoked certificate; a valid order is required.
